definitions.explanation: A state of being relaxed or free from difficulty.

examples.japanese: この{椅子|いす}は{楽|らく}だ。

examples.english: To become easier; to feel relieved.

notes:
{楽|らく} means ease or comfort.

AS NA-ADJECTIVE:
{楽|らく}な: easy, comfortable, relaxed

EXPRESSIONS:
- {楽|らく}をする: to take it easy
- {気|き}が{楽|らく}: feeling at ease
- {楽|らく}に{考|かんが}える: to think positively

COMPOUNDS:
- {楽観|らっかん}: optimism
- {気楽|きらく}: carefree
- {安楽|あんらく}: comfort, ease
